items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: We was going to the giant Charlotte Cref Band, me and Johnny.

ctx.x: And poor Johnny had a, Johnny had a, Johnny had a, Johnny had a, Johnny had a, Johnny had a

with a big drawers, big cotton drawers, big cotton drawers. And they were going with a paper sack. And poor Johnny had a, Johnny had a, Johnny had a, those were those big drawers, big cotton drawers going away. And the hand, the nickel hand sages, we all knew we had a nickel hand sages, that was going to last him from New Orleans' descent to, to, to, to, to, we had to go to Rock Island. See, we first stopped off at the Duke and played that night and joined a local. See, there was no, there was no local, I didn't…
Yeah, John Robichaud, some of them organized one way back there. Way back there.
